verdict.rationale: Semgrep's own docs say it can scan any codebase. Its Supply Chain SCA tool inventories dependencies by parsing manifests, and generic pattern matching covers languages Semgrep does not yet support. Community reports confirm multi-language use (JS, TS, Ruby, YAML, HTML, CSS; per-language rulesets), though one user hit a TypeScript parse failure. Missing for 10: a documented list of supported languages and their analysis depth, a documented list of supported package ecosystems or manifest/lockfile formats for Supply Chain, and independent confirmation of breadth across all major ecosystems.

support.subject: As a developer, I can scan projects across all the major languages and package ecosystems my organization uses
